auth_otp.body: {code} is your verification code. For your security, do not share this code.

invitation.subject: You are invited to join {account_name} on Eeasy Logistics
invitation.body:
You have been invited to join {account_name} on Eeasy Logistics.

Accept the invitation within 72 hours:
{link}

If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Reset your Eeasy Logistics password
password_reset.body:
We received a request to reset your Eeasy Logistics password.

Set a new password within 30 minutes:
{link}

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

platform_invitation.subject: You are invited to the Eeasy Logistics platform console
platform_invitation.body:
You have been invited to the Eeasy Logistics platform console.

Accept the invitation:
{link}

If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.

second_factor_reset.subject: Set up your Eeasy Logistics verification again
second_factor_reset.body:
Your second factor for Eeasy Logistics was reset by an administrator of your account.

Set up a new verification phone within 24 hours (you will need your password):
{link}

If you did not expect this, contact the owner of your account.

platform_totp_reset.subject: Your Eeasy Logistics console authenticator was reset
platform_totp_reset.body:
Your authenticator for the Eeasy Logistics platform console was reset by an administrator.

Sign in to the console with your password to set up your authenticator app again.

If you did not expect this, contact a platform super admin.
